what: Hovering a big series-name row (tab) draws a 2px underline 11px below the row, and the paired panel rises from 30px below over .3s ease and swaps. The two photos in the panel start upright 10px lower, then the second tilts 3° first and the first tilts -2° .1s later as they turn on (.3s ease), like two instant photos overlapped in a staggered way — a spot that swaps a representative photo per name in series·corner lists

options.on: If click, hovering doesn’t change it and you must press (default hover — devices without hover always use press)
options.--fx-dur: Duration for panels and photos to turn on (css variable), default .3s
options.--fx-lag: Delay before the first sheet turns on (css variable), default .1s
options.--fx-rise: Distance the panel rises (css variable), default 30px
options.--fx-tilt-a · --fx-tilt-b: First and second sheet tilt (css variable), default -2deg · 3deg
options.--fx-line-gap: Distance the underline drops below the name (css variable), default -11px
options.[data-fx-part=tab]: Name row (multiple) — is-active on the lit one
options.[data-fx-part=panel]: Panels in the same order as the tabs (several) — only the active one shows
options.[data-fx-part=photo]: Two photos inside the panel (the front one is first) — position and overlap are up to the consumer’s css

from.where: index.html series section (.gh-regular — seven large series names on the right, two Polaroids 356px·280px on the left)
